messages:
alex: Heads up — Datadog asked for a joint sandbox build + marketplace tile demo for our inference tracing. They want a working trace pipeline we can point to during the press demo next month.

maria: Timeline? and scope — just traces or dashboards too?

jess: We should include both: traces + a sample dashboard with model-level latency & cache hit metrics. For traces we need a schema first (span names + attributes).

dan: SI partners will need a packaging path for air-gapped customers. cc @samir from SI to confirm constraints.

samir: We can support air-gapped setups but prefer an OTLP file export fallback and a pre-bundled dd-agent. Need a small playbook.

ops-bot: smoke-test-request: please confirm end-to-end trace, 1k sample traces, model.version tag present, PII redaction validated.

maria: Important: product requires token-level redaction. We can't send raw prompt_text to Datadog for customers who opt out. Need KMS-backed key management for any exported trace payloads.

jess: Agreed. Draft OTEL schema (high-level): span names -> inference.request, tokenize, model.forward, kv.cache.hit, kv.cache.miss, exporter.send. Attributes -> model.name, model.version, shard.id, prompt_id(hashed), sampling.priority. Will add a processor to strip prompt_text.

jess: sample config to test locally:

```yaml
exporter:
  datadog:
    url: https://trace.datadoghq.com
    api_key_env: DD_API_KEY
processors:
  - redact:
      fields: [prompt_text, user_email]
  - attributes:
      add:
        model.version: "rwi-1.2"
        service.name: "redwood-runtime"
```

alex: Good. Who owns the smoke tests and the dashboard tile? Sandbox target: 2026-04-15, press deck by 2026-04-22.

jess: eng-ml owns trace schema + smoke tests. I'll own the dashboard proto.

dan: I'll coordinate SI packaging and Datadog contact. Setting up weekly 30m sync starting next Tue. Link to POC: https://drive.redwood/telemetry/llm-tracing-proposal-v1

samir: For air-gapped: playbook items I need from eng: collector sidecar asset, expected file export format, and env var mapping for DD. I'll draft the playbook this week.

maria: Privacy checklist: token hashing, prompt redaction, retention TTL for traces, and ensuring trace IDs don't leak PII. Legal needs to sign off on schema for marketplace tile.

jess: Also a technical ask: we should emit lightweight token-span sampling for high throughput models (emit top-k spans per request or sample 1 in N tokens) to control ingestion. Will include sampling controls in the exporter.

alex: Good call. Datadog quota could be a blocker — please ping the DD rep for recommended sampling config and expected ingestion for 100 req/s at 2k tokens/req.

jess: will ping them now.

dan: i'll invite DD PM & SI leads to the weekly.

maria: :thumbsup: anything else blocking?

jess: Need a small demo dataset (anonymized) to validate dashboards. Can someone from product supply 50 anon prompts?

samir: SI can help generate synthetic traffic once we have the schema.

alex: thanks all — i'll update launch doc with owners + timeline and ping legal on DPA for traces.

jess: added a short checklist for the sync: 1) schema sign-off, 2) PII redaction demo, 3) sandbox deploy, 4) dashboard from sample traces.

maria: :eyes: i'll review the checklist by EOD.

(End of thread)
